memo.headline: AI Inference looks like a Voice AI component, not a standalone category; invest in it as part of the voice stack.
memo.memo:
Behavioral: 129 accounts use AI Inference (32.2% adoption), but standalone usage share is 10.0% against an effective threshold of 35.0%. Only 17 accounts are standalone and 111 are attached. 12-month retention is 45.5% for standalone (n=11) and 72.4% for attached (n=29). Both samples are small. Median time to attach is 2 months.

Pipeline: 19 of 50 transcripts mention it, and 5 frame it as standalone. Standalone demand share is 10.0% against a 15.0% minimum. That gap is the sensitive check. Standalone win rate is 25.0% on 4 closed deals, versus 71.4% when bundled. Top loss concerns are price, model breadth and maturity. Main competitors are Together AI, OpenAI and Baseten.

Self-serve: the 90-day paid rate is 20.4% with voice and 2.4% without. That is why the threshold was raised.

What would change the call: standalone demand share clearing 15.0%, or standalone retention holding up on a larger sample.

Next action: position inference as a Voice AI capability and bundle it there. Retest standalone demand next quarter. The data is synthetic.
